title: Roadmap 2025
body:
This is ClickHouse roadmap 2025.

This roadmap does not cover the tasks related to infrastructure, orchestration, documentation, marketing, external integrations, drivers, etc.

See also:

Roadmap 2024: https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/58392
Roadmap 2023: https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/44767
Roadmap 2022: https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/32513
Roadmap 2021: https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/issues/17623
Roadmap 2020: [link](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/blob/be29057de1835f6f4a17e03a422b45b81efe6833/docs/ru/whats-new/extended-roadmap.md)


## Data Lakes

- [x] Automatic use of cluster functions #70659
- [x] Parallel distributed INSERT SELECT by default #80425
- [x] Enable Hive-style partitioning by default #71636
- [x] Uniform distribution of load across cluster #70190
- [x] Partition pruning for Iceberg #72044
- [x] Prewhere support for Parquet #65527
- [x] Unify different Parquet readers into one #70611
- [x] Writing bloom filters for Parquet #71681
- [x] Time travel for Iceberg #71072
- [x] Support for deletions in Iceberg #66588 #83627
- [x] In-memory metadata cache #71579
- [x] Integration with Delta kernel #75255
- [x] Glue catalog support #76988
- [x] Unity catalog support #77257
- [x] Support for Delta Lake on Azure #74541
- [ ] Materialized views on top of data lakes
- [ ] Support arbitrary nesting in database and table names #71171
- [x] Writing into data lakes #49973
- [ ] Background merges for data lakes ☁ 
- [x] Subsets of a large file as a unit of work

## Query Engine

- [x] Non-constant CASE, non-constant IN #65398
- [ ] Using a partition key to optimize JOINs
- [ ] Optimization of anti-joins: LEFT JOIN ... WHERE ... IS NULL to NOT IN
- [ ] Deriving index condition from the right-hand side of INNER JOIN
- [ ] Automatic JOINs in external memory, if needed
- [ ] Optimization for certain cases of distributed JOINs
- [x] JOIN reordering based on finer-grained statistics
- [x] Correlated subqueries with decorrelation #66143 #76078
- [x] PREWHERE to work with the FINAL clause #70210
- [x] Secondary indices to work with the FINAL clause #70292
- [ ] Support for certain SQL functions without parentheses #52102
- [x] Unification of table structures in Merge tables #73956
- [ ] Optimizations for a single dictionary in LowCardinality #72717
- [ ] Materialized CTE #61086
- [x] Query conditions cache #69236
- [x] Userspace page cache #70509
- [x] Lazy columns #55518
- [ ] Block-level hints #48800
- [ ] Query cache for partial results #57490
- [ ] On-disk query cache #52141
- [ ] Streaming queries #63312


## Data Storage

- [x] JSON data type from beta to production #77785 See https://jsonbench.com/
- [ ] Unique key constraint #70589
- [x] Lightweight updates with patch parts #82004
- [ ] Automatic LowCardinality columns #69916
- [x] Secondary indices by default #72090
- [ ] ShardedMap data type #47045
- [x] Time data type #71943
- [ ] Unify statistics with secondary indices
- [x] Production-ready full-text index #86485
- [ ] Functions and codecs for quantization
- [x] Production-ready vector search
- [x] Allow to instantly attach backups #64222
- [ ] Transactions for Replicated tables


## Interfaces

- [x] Random early drop on overload #63206
- [x] Resource scheduler by CPU #77595
- [x] Support for PromQL #75036
- [ ] Configuration of query handlers with SQL
- [ ] Remote and Cloud database engines #59304
- [ ] Drivers for UDFs #71172
- [ ] API for query construction #64336
- [ ] Even simpler data upload #38775
- [ ] Passing input data to the url table function #45994
- [x] Support for TLS in the PostgreSQL wire protocol #73812
- [ ] Support for HTTP Event-Stream
- [x] Persistent databases in clickhouse-local #71722
- [x] Implicit tables in clickhouse-local #65023
- [x] SSH protocol for the server #48902
- [ ] Predictive autocomplete in the CLI #69641


## Cleanups

- [ ] Remove old analyzer
- [ ] Remove old predicate pushdown mechanics
- [x] Remove Object data type in favor of JSON
- [ ] Remove Window View in favor of streaming queries
- [x] Remove Live View in favor of streaming queries
- [x] Remove the old cache for Hive #77795
- [x] Remove the "send metadata" feature #82508

no index or selects for such columns

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
@participant10, `String` in ClickHouse stores arbitrary binary data. I use it to backup my photos from travel (and also serve them by ClickHouse as well): https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse/blob/master/utils/backup/backup

There is absolutely no need for a separate BLOB data type. Moreover, when you type BLOB in ClickHouse, it is automatically interpreted as `String`.

comments.author: participant14
comments.body: @reporter  One of the critical piece of work that we have been seeing quite often is that we are unable to create DDL atomically (add columns, drop columns and rename column )  across all replicas. This creates problems to have inconsistent ddls across multiple replicas.  Historically we have been seeing that the mutations are not getting created if ZK is busy or if CH is very busy and eventually getting timed out. Is it possible to add this if this is not too much to ask ?

comments.author: participant15
comments.body:
> Production-ready full text search index

Very very excited to hear this. Are there any more details on the kind of things this effort would be addressing?

I've wanted to use it for a long time as the performance is great in the ideal case, but every time I use it, I inevitably run into weird performance/stability problems - OOMs, seemingly not respecting order by read optimization, very long cold start query times, etc.

My next vote after replicated engine transactions would be transactions across materialized views
